title: ART-DEX: Monitoring Broadly Neutralizing Antibody Activity in HIV-1 Therapy
author: Schwarzmüller, Trkola

steps.title: Seed HEK 293‑T cells
steps.instruction: Add 2.25 × 10⁶ HEK 293‑T cells to each 75 cm² cell culture flask.

steps.title: Incubate cells overnight
steps.instruction: Place the flasks in a 37 °C incubator with 5 % CO₂ and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Transfect cells with Env and backbone
steps.instruction: Introduce the Env‑encoding plasmid and pseudovirus backbone into the HEK 293‑T cells using PEI‑MAX.

substeps.instruction: Mix 5 µg Env plasmid and 15 µg NLluc‑AM4 (or NLluc‑AM MDR) backbone vector in 4 mL DMEM.
Add 60 µg polyethyleneimine MAX to the mixture.
Incubate the transfection mixture at room temperature for 20 min.
Add the mixture dropwise to the HEK 293‑T cells.
Incubate the cells for 8 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Replace the medium with fresh DMEM‑10 and continue incubation for 48 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Harvest and store pseudovirus
steps.instruction: Collect the virus‑containing supernatant, filter, and freeze‑store aliquots.

substeps.instruction: Pass the culture supernatant through a Steriflip 0.22 µm filter unit.
Aliquot the filtered pseudovirus and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Determine pseudovirus infectivity
steps.instruction: Perform a luciferase‑based titration assay to calculate the RLU/µL of each pseudovirus stock.

substeps.instruction: Serially dilute the frozen pseudovirus in DMEM‑10, starting with undiluted virus (e.g., 1:4 dilution series for five steps).
Add 100 µL of each virus dilution to 100 µL of TZM‑bl cells (1 × 10⁴ cells per well) seeded in a 96‑well plate.
Incubate the plates for 48–72 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Remove the media from each well carefully.
Add 50 µL of luciferase lysis buffer to each well and incubate 5 min.
Add 50 µL of Bright‑Glo luciferase substrate (diluted 1:10 in lysis buffer) to each well.
Read luminescence on a PerkinElmer plate reader within 30 min.

Normalize background‑corrected RLU values to virus input and calculate the average titer (RLU/µL) over the linear range of the dilution curve. Minimum acceptable titer is >100 RLU/µL; optimal >500 RLU/µL.

steps.title: Treat plasma with basic pH
steps.instruction: Release ARVs from plasma proteins by alkaline incubation.

substeps.instruction: Dilute plasma 1:2.5 with phosphate buffer, pH 10.0.
Incubate the diluted plasma for 2 h at room temperature.
Verify that the buffer pH is exactly 10.0 before use.

steps.title: Perform phosphate‑buffer size‑exclusion filtration
steps.instruction: Remove small molecules and buffer exchange using Zeba Spin Plate (40 kDa MWCO) with phosphate buffer, pH 10.0.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the Zeba Spin Plate for 2 min at 700 × g to discard the storage buffer.
Add 150 µL phosphate buffer (pH 10.0) to each column and centrifuge 2 min at 700 × g.
Repeat the wash step two more times (total of three washes).
Centrifuge the plate for 3 min at 700 × g to equilibrate.
Add 30–100 µL of the alkaline‑treated plasma sample to each column.
Centrifuge 3 min at 700 × g to collect the filtrate.
Note: 10–15 µL sample loss may occur during centrifugation.

steps.title: Treat plasma with acidic pH
steps.instruction: Further release ARVs by acidic incubation of the eluate.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the eluate 1:2 with acetate buffer, pH 3.6.
Incubate the mixture for 1 h at room temperature.
Confirm that the acetate buffer pH is exactly 3.6 before use.

steps.title: Perform acetate‑buffer size‑exclusion filtration
steps.instruction: Repeat size‑exclusion filtration using Zeba Spin Plate (40 kDa MWCO) with acetate buffer, pH 3.6.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the Zeba Spin Plate for 2 min at 700 × g to remove the previous buffer.
Add 150 µL acetate buffer (pH 3.6) to each column and centrifuge 2 min at 700 × g.
Repeat the acetate‑buffer wash two more times (total of three washes).
Centrifuge the plate for 3 min at 700 × g to equilibrate.
Add 30–100 µL of the acidic‑treated plasma sample to each column.
Centrifuge 3 min at 700 × g to collect the filtrate.
Note: 10–15 µL sample loss may occur during centrifugation.

steps.title: Neutralize plasma eluate for assay
steps.instruction: Adjust the pH of the final plasma eluate to physiological range before neutralization testing.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the eluate 1:5 with DMEM‑10 containing 25 mM HEPES.
Proceed directly to the TZM‑bl neutralization assay after this step.
